name: dfsane
title: Solving Large-Scale Nonlinear System of Equations

origin.description: Derivative-free spectral residual method. Nelder-Mead and L-BFGS-B are optional and off by default.
origin.usage: dfsane(par, fn, method=2, control=list(), quiet=FALSE, alertConvergence=TRUE, ...)

arguments.name: fn
arguments.text: Function returning a residual vector of the same length as par.

arguments.name: control
arguments.text: maxit, M, tol, trace, triter, noimp, NM, and BFGS.

origin.details: DF-SANE with the two-sided nonmonotone line search. NM and BFGS stay off unless control asks for them.
origin.value: The same list the R function returns for this case.
